diagnostics.meaning: Envelope does not conform to the versioned EFS execution envelope schema.
Envelope release coordinates do not match the selected immutable release.
Capability identifier does not resolve exactly once in the selected release.
Envelope contract identifier/version differs from the selected capability contract.
Execution profile is not explicitly and uniquely selected by the capability.
Execution mode is not declared by the selected embedded execution profile.
Error code is not declared by the selected capability contract.
Observed message transition is not permitted by the mode contract.
Invocation identifier changed during one interaction.
Correlation identifier changed during one interaction.
Causation identifier does not reference the preceding observed message.
